resolved_intent: A booking appears on every UTC day its slot overlaps: in the carrier's dispatcher list, in the shift lead's schedule and in each day's export.

grounding.claim: The dispatcher's booking list and the shift lead's day schedule both select a day's bookings by the date of the slot's start.
grounding.label: verified
grounding.source: the day query in the schedule module, line 41, at commit-finch

grounding.claim: A slot is stored as a start and an end in UTC, and the end is exclusive: a slot that ends at 06:00 leaves the door free at 06:00.
grounding.label: verified
grounding.source: the clash check in the booking module, line 88, at commit-finch, and its tests

grounding.claim: The booking in the request, carrier account 2207 at door 12 from 2030-10-21T22:30:00Z to 2030-10-22T01:30:00Z, is one stored record with that start and end.
grounding.label: verified
grounding.source: read-only query on production, run by the project manager at 2030-10-14T09:20:00Z

grounding.claim: Every booking in the fixtures starts and ends between 08:00 and 12:00 on a single day.
grounding.label: verified
grounding.source: the booking fixtures: 12 bookings, the earliest starting 08:00, the latest ending 11:30

grounding.claim: The day export selects its rows through the same day query.
grounding.label: unknown
grounding.source: not read. The export lists the same bookings as the schedule for every fixture, which does not show where it selects them; the implementer confirms in the code

grounding.claim: The carrier filter is applied in the service layer and again by the per-carrier database view; neither is in the lines this fix changes.
grounding.label: verified
grounding.source: the booking service, lines 31 to 44; the view definition in migration mig-0019

grounding.claim: Stored bookings are not to be split.
grounding.label: verified
grounding.source: questions.jsonl Q1, answered by the owner at 2030-10-14T13:52:00Z

assumptions_taken: A booking that crosses midnight shows its full start and end times on both days, not cut at 00:00, so the dock sees when the truck actually arrives and leaves. Reversible: display only.
surfaces: carrier dispatcher's booking list, by day
day export: one file per day, downloaded by dispatchers and shift leads

acceptance.criterion: A booking from 22:30 to 01:30 appears on both days: in the carrier dispatcher's list, in the shift lead's schedule and in each day's export.
acceptance.hard_case: awkward input at a boundary: a slot across midnight UTC, on the deployment through the hosted journey, with each day's export downloaded and read, not only the pages

acceptance.criterion: A booking that ends exactly at 00:00 appears on the first day only, on every surface.
acceptance.hard_case: the half-open end: a slot from 22:00 to 00:00 must not appear on the next day; and two back-to-back slots at one door, 23:00 to 00:00 and 00:00 to 01:00, each appear on their own day only

acceptance.criterion: A booking inside a single day is unaffected.
acceptance.hard_case: a mid-morning slot appears on its own day only, the same before and after the change

acceptance.criterion: A dispatcher at another carrier sees none of these bookings, on either day, in the list or in the export.
acceptance.hard_case: cross-tenant negative: signed in as a dispatcher at a second test carrier, expect none of the first carrier's bookings on both days and zero of its rows in both exports

routing: No schema change, no new visual pattern, and no change to auth, permissions, the tenant filter or storage: code, then QC. The cross-tenant criterion guards the filter; it does not change it.

baseline.migration_state: mig-0031 in place, nothing pending, measured on production at 2030-10-14T09:20:00Z
